content.title: How Hims & Hers founder Joe Spector turned 10 failures into $1B idea
content.description:
Listen and subscribe to The Big Idea with Elizabeth Gore on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you find your favorite podcast.

How do you break into a tough market and win? This CEO has done it twice.

This week on The Big Idea with Elizabeth Gore, Dutch Pet, Inc. founder and CEO Joe Spector joins the show to answer the question: How can I break into a complex market? Spector, also the co-founder of the public health company Hims & Hers (HIMS), transformed the telehealth sector for both humans and animals through the creation of Hims & Hers and now Dutch. Spector shares his story of perseverance and resilience as both an immigrant coming to America and an entrepreneur, while also offering actionable insight for other entrepreneurs looking to enter a complex market of their own.

Yahoo Finance’s The Big Idea with Elizabeth Gore takes you on a journey with America’s entrepreneurs as they navigate the world of small business.

This post was written by Lauren Pokedoff

Year to date, Hims & Hers has skyrocketed 130.8%, and over the past year, returns stand at an eye-popping 210.6%.
